turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to get serious about Japanese and I've narrowed it down to three ways.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A popular app with games and streaks, cheap and fun, but I've heard it doesn't teach much speaking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A textbook course with a workbook and audio, very thorough, though I'd be studying completely on my own.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Online lessons with a tutor in Osaka twice a week, pricier, but I'd actually be talking from day one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, that's all of them. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If speaking matters most to you, the tutor is the clear winner, even if it costs more. The textbook gives you structure, and the app is a nice extra rather than the main course.
